description: Policy gate with a signed receipt: your JsonLogic rules vs a proposed tool call or payment — Evaluates your own policy (JsonLogic rules, each allow or deny, deny-overrides or first-match, default deny) against a proposed tool call, payment or action, and returns allow or deny, the rule id that decided, and a receipt signed by the hub over the hashes of the policy, the request and the decision. The receipt is the product: another agent or an auditor can verify offline which rule allowed th

language.description: Default jsonlogic. cedar and rego return unsupported.

policy.description: JsonLogic: { rules: [{ id, effect: allow|deny, when: <JsonLogic>, description? }] (at most 100), combining?: deny-overrides|first-match, defaultEffect?: deny|allow }. A string for cedar/rego.

request.description: The proposed action as JSON (at most 65536 bytes), e.g. { tool, args, amountUsd, payee }. Rules read it with { "var": "args.amountUsd" }.

name: policy-gate
